verdict.summary: The change correctly checks out the landed merge commit before inspecting manifests, reuses gate G1's exact new-crate detection and publish=false classification, fans out deterministically per added crate, expands per-crate labels before routing, and suppresses user-facing follow-ons for internal crates while retaining test follow-ons. Configuration errors for unsupported fan-out modes and unsafe crate-label usage fail loudly. The focused tests exercise multi-crate fan-out, nested-manifest rejection, public/internal behavior, label routing, dry-run output, and invalid configuration; the relevant test suite passes (48 tests). No correctness, soundness, security, or vacuous-test issue was found in the diff.
